name: er-orders
_comment: The CUSTOMER/ORDER/INVOICE ER diagram from the mermaid docs that triggered this investigation. Node order = first-seen entity order: 0 CUSTOMER, 1 DELIVERY-ADDRESS, 2 ORDER, 3 INVOICE, 4 ORDER-ITEM, 5 PRODUCT-CATEGORY, 6 PRODUCT. Sizes are representative header-only entity boxes / edge-label boxes (font 16px); the exact values are arbitrary as long as BOTH engines get them.
